summary: PowerShell snippets to remove all WinRM listeners, or only HTTP or only HTTPS listeners.
questions: How do I delete WinRM listeners on a Windows host?
How can I remove just the HTTP WinRM listener and keep HTTPS?

answer_card.title: Removing WinRM listeners
answer_card.answer_md:
```powershell
# All listeners
Remove-Item -Path WSMan:\localhost\Listener\* -Recurse -Force

# Only HTTP (use Transport=HTTPS for HTTPS only)
Get-ChildItem -Path WSMan:\localhost\Listener |
    Where-Object Keys -contains "Transport=HTTP" |
    Remove-Item -Recurse -Force
```
